items.statement: 611k views in first 60 days after launch
items.desc: Luxury retreat in Tuscany, we made viral for its beautiful interiors, incredible gardens and sweeping views of the Castle of Sorbello and the renowned Castle Reschio hotel.
items.brief: Villa Sartiano is a luxury Tuscan retreat with extraordinary interiors, gardens and views, but it had little social momentum. The challenge was to translate the beauty and exclusivity of the property into content that would stop people scrolling and make the villa feel aspirational, memorable and worth enquiring about.
items.objective: Position Villa Sartiano as a must-visit luxury destination, build awareness with a wider travel audience, and turn attention on social media into meaningful engagement, profile growth and direct interest from potential guests.
items.strategy: Lead with the setting, atmosphere and emotional pull of the villa. We built a content strategy around the property’s architecture, interiors, landscape and guest experience, using storytelling-led short-form content to make the estate feel both luxurious and deeply desirable. The focus was on creating content native to TikTok and Instagram that felt elegant, immersive and shareable.
items.activity: Creative direction and content strategy; concepting and scripting; short-form video creation and editing; platform-specific publishing; performance monitoring and optimisation; profile building across TikTok and Instagram; and storytelling-led content designed to grow awareness, engagement and enquiries.

items.statement: Millions of views built from the ground up.
items.desc: A vintage brand with a unique spin on micro minis launched with zero following and zero views. We built the entire social strategy from the ground up.
items.brief: Gigi Clothing launched with no audience, no content and no social presence: a handmade London product with a strong point of view and nobody watching. Everything had to be built from nothing.
items.objective: Turn a new label into a name people recognised, and turn attention into orders rather than only views.
items.strategy: Lead with the product as the character. Micro minis are divisive, so we built creative that let the comments argue; trend-aware formats, clear product hooks in the first second, and a posting rhythm that kept the account in front of new audiences rather than the same followers.
items.activity: Creative direction, concepting and scripting; daily short-form production and editing; publishing and growth management; comment-led community building; campaign moments around drops.

items.statement: Designing a viral social media personal brand.
items.desc: From 0 to 200,000 followers in 16 months, with daily videos reaching hundreds of thousands to millions of viewers worldwide.
items.brief: Caroline is a British novelist celebrated for her historical fiction. She had around 5,000 Instagram followers and no TikTok presence. She had moved from manager to manager trying different approaches, but nothing stuck: content was inconsistent, growth had plateaued, and her top posts around book launches averaged 100 likes, 10 comments and no shares.
items.objective: Build a personal brand that audiences would not just follow, but genuinely connect with, one that reflected the scale of her work.
items.strategy: Make TikTok the focus and build Caroline’s brand around video content that would connect with #BookTok audiences globally. Her real life — the house, the writing routine, the reading — was the format, not a backdrop.
items.activity: Viral video concepts positioning Caroline at the heart of the global #BookTok community; end-to-end social management from filming and editing to publishing and growth strategy; curated and negotiated high-value brand partnerships aligned with her author brand.

metrics.lab: Instagram followers, organically, as a knock-on effect

items.quote: Today Caroline has a clear, consistent presence that reflects her voice and resonates with readers worldwide.

items.statement: Finding a global audience through viral video.
items.desc: An online ballet studio and app where the world’s best dancers teach everyone. We led creative across marketing, social and podcast.
items.brief: Grace & Form needed to carve out a distinct voice in a crowded wellness space while staying true to the artistry of ballet — and to turn social into an engine for app sign-ups and podcast listens, not just reach.
items.objective: Position Grace & Form at the intersection of performance and fitness, and build a global hub for ballet-inspired training.
items.strategy: Build the strategy around collaboration with world-renowned principal dancers. Real technique, real names, filmed in the studio — performance-led storytelling rather than fitness-content conventions.
items.activity: All creative ideation across marketing and social, setting tone of voice and visual direction; comprehensive social strategy from concept to growth management; brand alignment across every channel; end-to-end delivery — filming, editing, publishing; curated and negotiated brand partnerships aligned with the dancers and founders.

items.statement: Turning floral artistry into a social destination.
items.desc: A complete rebrand for nutritional therapist Stéphanie Achar — visual identity, tone of voice, colour and social strategy.
items.brief: BREIGE creates extraordinary, season-led floral installations for luxury weddings and events. The work was already exceptional; our job was to build a social presence that communicated the scale, artistry and distinctive British sensibility of the brand to a much wider audience.
items.objective: Establish BREIGE as a recognisable name in luxury floral and event design, grow awareness beyond its existing audience, and put the work in front of prospective couples, planners, venues and design-led audiences.
items.strategy: Treat every wedding as a visual story. We combined breathtaking transformations with simple, highly shareable hooks that made the scale of the work instantly understandable. Content moved between the finished spectacle, the creative process and Breige herself, positioning her not simply as a florist, but as the artist and creative force behind each environment.
items.activity: Social strategy and creative direction; concepting and hook development; short-form editing and publishing; wedding and event storytelling; founder-led content; trend-led formats; community growth; and ongoing optimisation around reach, saves and shares.

items.statement: A B2B podcast that found a public audience.
items.desc: Podcast-led social for an energy sector audience, rebuilt around clips that travel beyond the industry.
items.brief: A specialist podcast with valuable conversations and almost no reach outside its existing followers.
items.objective: Reach people who had never heard of the show, without dumbing down the subject.
items.strategy: Find the one line in each episode a non-specialist would repeat, and build the clip around it. Publish for non-followers by design.
items.activity: Clip selection and editing, caption and hook writing, publishing schedule, community response management.

items.brief: Sandon Hall is an extraordinary English country house wedding venue with history, character and beautiful interiors and grounds. Our job was to translate the experience of the estate onto social, creating a presence that felt as distinctive, romantic and memorable as the venue itself.
items.objective: Position Sandon Hall as one of the UK’s most desirable country house wedding destinations, grow awareness amongst a new generation of couples, and turn social discovery into genuine consideration, enquiries and viewings.
items.strategy: Make people fall in love with the venue before they ever visit. We treated the house as the main character, combining cinematic views of the interiors, gardens and weddings with emotionally-led, highly shareable hooks. From imagining your entrance down the staircase to seeing the estate transformed for a wedding, every piece of content was designed to make viewers picture their own day at Sandon Hall.
items.activity: Social strategy and creative direction; concepting and hook development; short-form content creation and editing; venue and wedding storytelling; trend-led formats; seasonal and behind-the-scenes content; publishing and community growth; and ongoing optimisation around reach, engagement and enquiries.

items.statement: Seen and shared millions of times.
items.desc: Birth trauma advocacy that moved from a podcast feed into national conversation.
items.brief: A subject people avoid, and an audience who needed to hear it. The show needed reach without sensationalism.
items.objective: Take difficult conversations to the people living them, and hold a community together in the comments.
items.strategy: Let the guests speak. Minimal edit, honest captions, and careful community management underneath every post.
items.activity: Clip production, publishing, community management, coverage support around BBC Woman’s Hour.
